data_science.title: PLC-DPO: Posterior Label Correction in Noisy and Ambiguous Preference Optimization
data_science.why_trending: Direct preference optimization (DPO) is a core methodology for aligning LLMs; handling noisy/ambiguous labels is a critical practical challenge as real-world preference data is often unreliable.

data_science.title: GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning
data_science.why_trending: RL with verifiable rewards is emerging as a key paradigm for LLM reasoning; understanding token importance illuminates why certain training signals yield strong performance gains.

data_science.title: SingProbe Technical Report
data_science.why_trending: Runtime safety for LLM deployment is increasingly critical; intrinsic guardrails that reuse hidden states offer a practical, efficient alternative to external safety models.

data_science.title: CoMPASS: Collaborative Molecular Property Prediction via Adaptive Small-Large Model Synergy
data_science.why_trending: Combining calibrated statistical models with LLM reasoning for molecular property prediction addresses a key challenge: knowing when LLM evidence should influence quantitative predictions.

data_science.title: BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs
data_science.why_trending: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for safely deploying black-box LLMs/VLMs in safety-critical settings; cross-temperature semantic agreement offers a novel black-box approach.

finance.title: Agentic Quantitative Trading: A Survey of Workflows, Systems, and Evaluation
finance.why_trending: Agentic workflows combining reasoning, tool use, and memory are becoming the dominant paradigm in quantitative trading; this survey captures a major industry shift from isolated models to integrated systems.

finance.title: Deep Hedging Under Realistic Market Frictions: A Regime-Conditional Empirical Study of Dynamic Option Hedging on Bitcoin Options
finance.why_trending: Deep hedging shows promise in live Bitcoin options markets, but comparisons to classical methods on realistic data (not simulations) reveal nuanced practical advantages and limitations.

finance.title: Optimal Block Time for AMM Liquidity Providers under Jump-Diffusion Prices
finance.why_trending: Jump-diffusion models for AMM liquidity provision address a key limitation of GBM assumptions; understanding how jumps interact with block times is crucial for DeFi protocol design.

finance.title: Tabular Deep Learning for Algorithmic Trading: Cross-Regime Bayesian Optimisation for Equity Signal Generation
finance.why_trending: Regime-robust hyperparameter selection for equity signal generation demonstrates that targeting robustness across market regimes yields meaningful out-of-sample gains.

finance.title: Wasserstein-Barycentric Interaction Fields for Spatial Factor Models: Evidence from Language-Model Representations
finance.why_trending: Using language-model embeddings to construct spatial factor models offers a novel data source for understanding cross-asset relationships without requiring direct return covariances.

social_sciences.title: When Can We Work in Embedding Space? What Text Embeddings Preserve
social_sciences.why_trending: Provides theoretical and empirical clarity on when text embeddings preserve information sufficient for downstream analysis; essential for validating embedding-based empirical work.

social_sciences.title: Tariff Threats, Macroeconomic Expectations, and Policy Communication Strategies: Experiments Based on a Multi-Agent System
social_sciences.why_trending: Uses multi-agent LLM simulation to study how policy communication moves household expectations; innovative method for studying macroeconomic belief formation at scale.

social_sciences.title: Content Exploration Beyond the Feed: Creator Supply and the Shared Corpus
social_sciences.why_trending: Decomposes platform recommendation effects from audience selection; shows production exploration raises creator supply by 8.5%, revealing feedback between exploration budgets and supply.

social_sciences.title: Decarbonising price formation: unit-level evidence on battery storage and the imbalance price in the GB Balancing Mechanism
social_sciences.why_trending: Documents battery storage's rise in GB Balancing Mechanism from 0.8% to 4.4% of marginal units; timely analysis of how storage reshapes electricity price formation.

social_sciences.title: The Race for Elite Destinations: Education Competition and Low Fertility in Korea
social_sciences.why_trending: Links intense education competition to South Korea's record-low fertility through quantified assignment externality; proposes lottery-based assignment increases fertility by 0.24 children per couple.

topics.name: LLM alignment, safety, and deployment
topics.summary: Papers addressing reliable preference optimization, runtime safety guardrails, uncertainty estimation, and neuron-level safety mechanisms to enable safe deployment of LLMs and vision-language models in production.

topics.name: Hybrid AI systems and model collaboration

topics.name: Neural network architectures for sequential and spatial data
topics.summary: Innovations in CNN-RNN hybrids, transformer-based seasonal modeling for time series, liquid gated attention for continuous-time dynamics, and quantum-inspired token mixing for computer vision.

topics.name: Molecular and materials discovery via machine learning
topics.summary: Graph neural networks with chemically grounded attributions for ADME properties and semi-supervised learning from scarce crystal data.

topics.name: Deep learning for financial derivatives and hedging
topics.summary: Neural network approaches to option hedging under realistic frictions, calibration of pricing trees, and structured trading agents.

topics.name: Market microstructure, decentralized finance, and price dynamics
topics.summary: Jump-diffusion analysis of AMM liquidity provision, metaorder modeling from public data, market design under jump-risk, and traveling waves in equity markets.

topics.name: Quantitative trading, signal generation, and factor models
topics.summary: Regime-robust hyperparameter tuning, Wasserstein-barycentric spatial factors from language models, and portfolio risk bounds without covariances.

topics.name: Credit risk, portfolio optimization, and financial risk management
topics.summary: Disentangled VAE for credit risk, interpretable hybrid scoring, latent-state credit models, amortized posterior approximation via conditional Wasserstein GANs, and temporal GNNs for systemic risk.

topics.name: Econometric methods, embeddings, and causal inference
topics.summary: Text embeddings for empirical analysis, moments of random coefficients in panels, high-dimensional network inference, decomposing audience preference from creative effect, and causal non-causal state-space models.

topics.summary: Creator supply responses to exploration budgets, strategic disclosure in curation, and sophistication variation in GenAI use across organizational functions.

topics.name: Macroeconomic expectations and policy analysis

topics.name: Mechanism design and economic theory

topics.name: Labor markets and education policy
topics.summary: Education competition's link to fertility in Korea and tracking occupation requirements from job ads to measure labor market shifts.

topics.name: Energy markets and decarbonization

topics.name: Computational complexity and bounded rationality
topics.summary: Framework for Bayesian decision-making showing that optimal choice can be computationally intractable even with small state/action spaces.
